text: So Neurological De-Armoring is about fixing the underpinnings first, rather than redecorating. The protocol works like a metabolic solvent, by supplementing Ketones (BHB), which block HDAC (an enzyme that keeps genes switched off), along with Glutamate modulation, to soften the "concrete" in the brainstem. That lets us dig under the house and pour a new foundation, so we can eventually update the psychological software upstairs.
section: Psychology is the Software; Biology is the Hardware.
reader: someone with trauma, often with addiction, who has done therapy and still reacts the same way, reading to learn why and whether this protocol is for them
